First release of Jever, a desktop app for TypeSafe Jev through OpenRouter.

### Downloads

| Platform                             | Download                    |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| macOS — Apple Silicon (M1 and later) | `Jever-0.0.1-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS — Intel                        | `Jever-0.0.1-mac-x64.dmg`   |
| Windows — x64                        | `Jever-0.0.1-win-x64.exe`   |

The macOS ZIP files contain the same app as the DMG installers. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for all installers and ZIP files.

### In this release

- Choice, Score, and yes/no questions in a conversation interface.
- Question presets, a visual editor, and JSON editing.
- Text attachments, background context, and optional conversation history.
- Confidence, probabilities, usage, and raw response details.
- Local conversation history, search, pins, and workspace backups.
- Light and dark themes with adjustable accent colors and text size.

### Getting started

Install the app, open **Settings → Connection**, and add an OpenRouter API key with credits and access to Jev. Your key is encrypted locally. Conversation files and exported backups are unencrypted; running a decision sends its context to OpenRouter.

### Installation notes

These are early, unsigned distribution builds. The macOS apps are ad-hoc signed but not Apple-notarized; macOS may block opening them. Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Install only if you trust this repository and its artifacts.

Automated tests and production builds run for each target. Packaging success does not verify every desktop interaction on each operating system.
